cards.korean_desc: 베라마니는 2026년 10월 28일 이스라엘 현장에서 사망했다 수리 중 멈춘 엘리베이터가 갑자기 내려갔다 시신은 11월 7일 첸나이에 도착해 묻혔다

cards.english_title: In India, living together no longer guarantees marriage
cards.korean_desc: 인도 커플들은 결혼을 미루거나 다시 생각하며 동거를 택한다. 어떤 커플은 동거를 시험으로 보고 다른 커플은 완전한 관계로 본다. 15세에서 29세 미혼 인도인은 2011년 17.2%에서 2019년 23%로 늘었다. 커플들은 책임과 동의와 일상적인 일을 계속 조율할 것이다.
cards.english_desc: Live-in relationships are becoming more visible as Indian couples delay or rethink marriage. Some couples see live-in relationships as a trial, while others see them as complete relationships. The share of Indians aged 15–29 who had never married rose from 17.2% in 2011 to 23% in 2019. The debate will continue as couples negotiate commitment, consent and everyday work.
cards.hook: Living together does not always point toward marriage.
cards.takeaway_english: The real question is not marriage or no marriage, but whether both partners want the same future.
cards.takeaway_korean: 진짜 질문은 결혼 여부보다 두 사람이 같은 미래를 원하는지다.

why_it_matters.english: Different expectations about marriage can create painful misunderstandings.
why_it_matters.korean: 결혼에 대한 기대가 다르면 큰 오해가 생길 수 있다.

why_it_matters.english: Consent still matters inside live-in relationships.

parties.label: Young Indians
parties.english: More young people are reaching marriage later than before.
parties.korean: 젊은 인도인들은 예전보다 늦게 결혼하고 있다.

parties.label: Women in Kerala
parties.english: Many want lasting marriages but worry about adjustment, careers and in-laws.
parties.korean: 많은 여성은 결혼을 원하지만 적응과 경력과 시댁을 걱정한다.

parties.label: Queer couples
parties.english: They may disagree about whether marriage is necessary for a shared life.
parties.korean: 퀴어 커플은 공동생활에 결혼이 필요한지 다를 수 있다.

views.label: Supporters of live-in relationships
views.english: Living together can reveal compatibility before legal and family ties become harder to unwind.
views.korean: 동거는 법적 가족 관계 전에 서로 맞는지 보여 줄 수 있다.

views.label: Critics of live-in relationships
views.english: One partner may enjoy comfort while avoiding the commitment expected from marriage.
views.korean: 한 사람은 결혼 책임 없이 편안함만 누릴 수 있다.

disagree.english: The evidence describes varied experiences, not one rule for all Indian couples.
disagree.korean: 자료는 모든 인도 커플의 규칙이 아닌 다양한 경험을 보여 준다.

cards.reader_question_korean: 동거 전에 연인은 무엇을 이야기해야 할까요?

cards.english_title: Manchester City Loses Again as Arsenal Pulls Six Points Clear
cards.korean_desc: 맨체스터 시티는 2026년 11월 7일 3대1로 졌다 이 결과로 시티는 리그 3연패를 당했다 자이르 쿤하가 먼저 넣고 델랍이 두 골을 더했다 아스널은 헐을 1대0으로 이겨 6점 앞섰다
cards.english_desc: Manchester City lost 3-1 at Nottingham Forest on November 7, 2026. The result gave City its third straight league defeat. Jair Cunha scored first, and Liam Delap added two goals for Forest. Arsenal beat Hull 1-0 and moved six points ahead of City.
cards.hook: Manchester City lost three straight; Arsenal led by six points.
cards.takeaway_english: The international break gives City time to repair its defense before the title race moves on.
cards.takeaway_korean: A매치 휴식은 맨시티 수비 회복 시간을 준다

why_it_matters.english: Arsenal’s lead changes the early shape of the title race.
Forest’s win lifted it away from immediate relegation danger.

parties.english: City lost 3-1 at Nottingham Forest after three consecutive defeats.

views.korean: 수비 실수가 포리스트의 두 골을 도왔다

disagree.english: Three losses look serious, but the season remains long and City started with seven wins.

cards.takeaway_english: The new series must feel different without losing the horror and mystery fans expect.

why_it_matters.english: The project extends one of Netflix’s most successful television worlds.
Its 1950s setting can show a different side of Hawkins.

cards.english_title: Krakow Shooting Leaves Death Toll Unclear
cards.korean_desc: 경찰은 그가 차에서 사람들을 무작위로 겨냥했다고 말했다 범인은 경찰과 대치 중 다쳤다 후속 보도는 더 큰 수치를 전했고 수사는 계속됐다
cards.english_desc: Police said he targeted random people from a moving vehicle. The gunman was wounded during a confrontation with police. Later updates gave higher figures, but investigations were continuing on November 8.
cards.hook: A Krakow shooting killed five people and injured more than twelve.
cards.takeaway_english: Investigators must establish both the final casualty count and the attack’s circumstances.
cards.takeaway_korean: 수사관들은 최종 사상자와 경위를 밝혀야 한다

why_it_matters.english: People need reliable information during a deadly attack.
why_it_matters.korean: 치명적 공격 때 정확한 정보가 필요하다

why_it_matters.english: The shooting affected a major public square in a large Polish city.
why_it_matters.korean: 폴란드 대도시의 공공 광장이 피해를 입었다

parties.label: Victims and families
parties.english: Five people were killed in the shooting described on November 8.

parties.label: Police
parties.english: Police wounded and detained the gunman after a confrontation.
parties.korean: 경찰은 범인을 쏴 다치게 하고 붙잡았다

parties.label: Donald Tusk
parties.english: Poland’s prime minister said police were investigating.

views.label: Police account
views.english: Police said the gunman fired randomly from a vehicle near Krakow’s Main Square.
views.korean: 경찰은 범인이 광장에서 무작위로 쐈다고 말했다

views.label: Later updates
views.english: Later reports gave higher figures, including six deaths and fifteen or sixteen injuries.
views.korean: 후속 보도는 6명 사망과 15명 또는 16명 부상을 전했다

disagree.english: The casualty figures changed across updates, so the final toll was not settled in the available accounts.
disagree.korean: 사상자 수가 바뀌어 최종 수치는 확정되지 않았다

cards.reader_question_korean: 바뀌는 사상자 수를 어떻게 알려야 할까요?
